ops-alerts-bot: ALERT: Detected degraded capacity in ap-south1 GPU pool (gpu-pool-07). Symptoms: increased egress latency to public peers, ~15% 5xxs on inference path, p99 token latency +350ms. Detect window 00:06 UTC.

maria (oncall): Acknowledged. Opening bridge and following infra runbook -> https://confluence/infra/runbooks/gpu-egress-deg. Marking Sev2 for now.

devin (net): Seeing BGP flap from ISP-AS[75432] affecting our egress path out of ap-south1. Traceroutes show asymmetric path and high packet loss to next-hop.

devin (net): ```
traceroute to 203.0.113.9 (203.0.113.9), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.1.1  0.23 ms  0.18 ms  0.15 ms
 2  198.51.100.1  12.3 ms  11.9 ms  12.1 ms
 3  203.0.113.1  120.7 ms  118.2 ms  121.1 ms
 4  * * *
 5  203.0.113.9  300.2 ms  298.7 ms  305.1 ms
```

alex (eng-runtime): Autoscaler attempted to spin up replacement instances but hit IPAM allocation blocks in ap-south1, and kube CNI reported ENI quota limits. That explains reduced capacity instead of quick reprovision.

raj (cust-sre): Customers impacted flagged: GrocerAI (high qps), Finlytics (SLA-sensitive), TutorFlow (bursty). I'm pinging account SREs and CS now. Recommend an immediate traffic-shift for new sessions; keep existing sessions sticky.

sophia (support): Drafting status page and support messages. Proposed short status: "Investigating increased errors and latency for API requests routed to ap-south1. Working on mitigation and temporary routing." OK to post?

maria (oncall): Post initial investigating status. Simultaneously prepare a mitigation: route new requests to asia-southeast-1 fallback region and throttle retries. Note: cost delta estimated +60% for affected tokens while routed.

devin (net): We can push a temporary egress filter to prefer our alternate peer and prefer direct circuit via singapore POP. Quick rule: prefer-route=asia-southeast-1, fallback=us-west1.

devin (net): Example traffic-shift config snippet: ```
route_policy: {
  prefer_regions: ["asia-southeast-1", "us-west1"],
  sticky_existing_sessions: true,
  max_retry: 1
}
```

alex (eng-runtime): I'll flip the routing policy for inbound new requests on the edge pool in 2 mins once we confirm customer throttle windows. Will also enable reduced batching to lower tail latency.

raj (cust-sre): Contacted GrocerAI and Finlytics; they're aware. GrocerAI asked for ETA and preferred manual failover. ETA: initial mitigation within 30m, full restoration depends on ISP convergence + IPAM fix (~2-4 hours).

sophia (support): Posted status page update: "Investigating — increased errors and latency for ap-south1. We are routing new requests to fallback regions and contacting affected customers." Added note about potential cost increase. Link -> https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2007778888

status-bot: STATUS PAGE UPDATED: incident 2007778888 set to Investigating.

maria (oncall): Action items: 1) devin to coordinate with ISP and BGP team; 2) alex to enact route change and monitor error-rate; 3) infra to request temporary IP quota bump from cloud provider for ap-south1; 4) support to maintain customer comms.

maria (oncall): ETA update: mitigation (traffic shift) in ~15–30m, partial capacity restored if IPAM quota granted in 1–3h, full stable state after ISP convergence ~3–5h. Will update every 30m or on milestone.

ops-alerts-bot: NOTE: cost tracker will log increased egress and cross-region token spend. Expect +50–80% cost delta for routed traffic; billing team notified.

status-bot: Next status update scheduled in 30 minutes or on bridge update.

alex (eng-runtime): Route flip started. Monitoring metrics: p50/p95 improving for new sessions in fallback region. Continuing to monitor KV cache impact for cross-region requests.

maria (oncall): Thanks team. Keep comms concise. If any customer requests manual failover, route via raj only.

sophia (support): Noted. Logged the three customers as high-priority in the support queue and shared the status-post link.

ops-alerts-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: incident 2007778888 created and assigned to oncall.
